 Ragdoll Robot Boxing codes (October 2026)
 Get Lucky Spins and Gears with these free codes!
 Image credit: Ragdoll Physics Experiences 
 Guide
 by Callum Williams 
 Guides Writer
Published on Oct. 30, 2026, 3:37 p.m. 
 Follow Ragdoll Robot Boxing
 Last updated : 30 October 2026 - Added new Ragdoll Robot Boxing codes!
 Roblox has been overflowing with new boxing games recently, but all of those things are missing a key component that Ragdoll Robot Boxing has in spades. While they feature big men throwing right hooks, none of them have sick fighting robots with bulldozer hands or two heads. That's right, this is basically a 3D version of Rock Em Sock Em Robots, and that means you engage in gnarly physics-based cybernetic throwdowns, where you need to dodge and weave with the mouse and throw punches to turn your foe into scraps.
 However, as I found in my first match, you start with a pretty generic android incapable of doing much of anything but losing. And if you want to inhabit a proper hunk of punching metal, you'll need to spin for a better bot to throw hands with. One of the easiest ways to get new fighters is to use redeemable codes, which you can redeem for Lucky Spins and Gears. To help you start winning more fights, we've compiled all of these Ragdoll Robot Boxing codes below, so you can start thrashing your enemies in style.

 How to redeem Ragdoll Robot Boxing codes
 Looking to cash in your Ragdoll Robot Boxing codes? Here's exactly how to cash them in:
 Launch Ragdoll Robot Boxing on Roblox. 
 Image credit: Rock Paper Shotgun / Ragdoll Physics Experiences 
 When you're in the lobby, click the " codes " button on the left-hand side of the screen. 
 Image credit: Rock Paper Shotgun / Ragdoll Physics Experiences 
 Punch your code into the bar that appears, then click the " REDEEM " button.
 If your code was successful, you'll see a notification with your rewards below the bar.
 How to get more Ragdoll Robot Boxing codes
 On the hunt for more Ragdoll Robot Boxing codes? We don't blame you! You want some mythic pulls to smash those other puny robots to scrap with. Our first suggestion would be to bookmark this page! We're always hunting for new codes, and we'll update our list the moment we find any for Ragdoll Robot Boxing, so keep checking in to see if any new ones have been added.
 Our other recommendation would be to become a member of the official Ragdoll Robot Boxing Discord server . Once a member, hop over to the " codes " channel, where you'll find new codes as they're added. They usually post new drops around updates or community milestones.
 Expired Ragdoll Robot Boxing codes
 There are currently no expired Ragdoll Robot Boxing codes . If that changes, we'll post any deactivated codes right here.
 And that's all you need to know to cash in your Ragdoll Robot Boxing codes. Looking for more codes? Check out our full lists of all the First Person Boxing codes , Survive A Million Monkeys codes and Fisch codes . But if none of those appeal, you can find our full list of Roblox guides here .
